purpose: Keep diagnostic stage 19 bounded, deterministic where possible, and personally filtered without turning free price into taste evidence.

authority.limit_override_reason: Two clean targeted attempts showed that the stage's required current cross-store giveaway discovery plus upcoming-event discovery and personal filtering is intrinsically an external-I/O stage. The optimized bounded path completed all required checks in about 72 seconds without large-page crawling. Raising only this stage to 90 seconds preserves fail-fast behavior while avoiding a false timeout; canonical mailing semantics are unchanged.

external_store_scope: other major legal PC stores with no-subscription permanent giveaways
freebies.external_discovery_strategy: Use one bounded web-search batch. Prefer a fresh cross-store giveaway index that states store, keep-forever status, subscription requirement, and last-check time. Do not open a large catalogue page when the search result already proves the active no-subscription offers and store counts.

upcoming.query_strategy: Use one bounded current web search for upcoming gaming showcases/events inside the horizon.
upcoming.relevance_requires: At least one concrete event feature, announced title, franchise, developer, gameplay focus, or structural theme that maps to a specific canonical positive profile anchor. Being a generic gaming event is not sufficient by itself.
upcoming.selection: nearest chronologically among events whose relevance is proven

preferred_target_operations: one GitHub read for Steam freebies
one bounded web-search batch for external no-subscription giveaways and upcoming events

pass_requires: Steam freebie feed checked exactly once
Epic and GOG no-subscription giveaway state checked
subscription-only benefits are not silently treated as universal freebies
every shown freebie meets canonical moderate taste threshold independent of price
upcoming event is either one nearest proven-relevant event or explicitly omitted because none was proven relevant
render contains only included paid recommendations and included freebies
